about: Every frame of the guns-mark board as its own PNG at native size: <option>_<scene>_z<zoom>[_ship].png are 1:1 crops of the game's own frames (the same crop for every option of a scene and view), context_coast_z0.35.png the whole 1280 x 720 frame of G0.

frames.title: G0 · Today  ·  bridge  ·  zoom 1.0
frames.caption: The reference: a dashed line from the node, a ring at the shells' two-sigma scatter, a small shell beside the node and an X at the target. Scene 'bridge': the cruiser's Main Guns on a point on the road beyond the bridge, 2.9 km away (the mission's real shot, the spread at its widest); the target end. 1:1 crop of the game's own frame, the target selection drawn.

frames.title: G1 · Scatter wash, quiet line  ·  bridge  ·  zoom 1.0
frames.caption: The scatter as a soft wash under one thin rim (the range of motion's grammar), the one-sigma core a shade deeper, a quiet solid line from the node. No X, no shell. Scene 'bridge': the cruiser's Main Guns on a point on the road beyond the bridge, 2.9 km away (the mission's real shot, the spread at its widest); the target end. 1:1 crop of the game's own frame, the target selection drawn.
